newsitem.title: UK: IPE extends rally as NYMEX heat breaks 70 cts.
newsitem.headline: IPE extends rally as NYMEX heat breaks 70 cts.

text.p: IPE Brent crude and gas oil futures continued climbing after the NYMEX open, extending earlier gains on forecasts of cold weather in Europe and the United States, brokers said.
January Brent stood 30 cents up at $22.82 per barrel at 1554 GMT while January gas oil gained $6.75 to $212.00 per tonne.
"Gas oil got a boost from heat going over 70 cents, but this market is still treacherous," said Charles Gray of Prudential Bache Futures in London.
Private forecasters WSC said western European temperatures would continue well below average for the time of year.
WSC also saw below-average temeratures in the U.S. midwest next week.

Gray said heavy oil price falls earlier this week had prompted increased domestic and retail buying of heating oil in Europe. He added that prices may have fallen too far, given that winter was only just starting.
Volume was slightly below average, brokers said, and many kept their eye on NYMEX December crude options expiry on Friday. They said the market should settle near $24.00 evens.
